title: RPCS3 0.0.32-16803: official stable release
summary: RPCS3 published 0.0.32-16803 on August 12, 2024. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 3 emulator project.

blocks.text: The RPCS3 project published version 0.0.32-16803 on August 12, 2024. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The release record publishes a SHA-256 checksum (69f98f5aceacd5738659fb995c0d5dbd27e3905565548607a0d95a1d43e1e7b1) and records an archive size of 29537747 bytes, approximately 29.5 MB. These values identify the distributed build without relying on an external summary.
